name: Smartsheet
summary: Smartsheet has no free plan. Pro costs $9 per member a month billed yearly for 1 to 10 members, and Business costs $19 for 3 or more members. Grid, Gantt, calendar, table and board views come with every plan, and a 30-day trial is offered.

facts.text: Grid, Gantt, Calendar, Table and Board views are included on all four plans, and a Timeline view needs Business or higher.
Comments and conversations, and assigning people to work, are included on all plans.
SAML single sign-on is listed for Enterprise and Advanced Work Management, while every plan allows sign-in with a Google, Microsoft or Apple account.
The page says the Pro plan is only available to new customers.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed yearly. $12 on monthly billing. For 1 to 10 members

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Billed yearly. $24 on monthly billing. For 3 or more members

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For 10 or more members. Includes SAML sign-in

hiddenCosts: The Timeline view and larger teams need Business, which has a 3-member minimum.
SAML single sign-on needs a quoted plan.
